thesis: The strongest short case is not balance-sheet weakness but concentration of physical capacity in Taiwan, customer concentration, a potentially cyclical AI capex boom, and structurally lower returns on overseas fabs. Current price is above Base DCF, so the stock needs durable owner-FCF growth. Yet leading-edge share, margins, net cash and demand data are strong enough that none of the exact Hard Veto predicates is established.

evidence.claim: 2025 top ten customers were 78% of revenue; largest customer 19%, second largest 17%.
2026 capex guidance is US$52B-$56B versus FY2025 capex about US$40.56B.
Current price is ~1.15x locked Base value.

unknowns: Probability and economic impact of severe Taiwan disruption
falsifiers: A material loss of advanced-node share, persistent margin compression, or customer insourcing at scale would strengthen the short thesis.

hard_veto_flags.veto: 경영진 정직성 또는 회계 신뢰성 훼손
hard_veto_flags.rationale: No restatement, auditor dispute or integrity impairment is established.
Internal cash generation and net cash fund the capex program.
No persistent excessive dilution is established.
Demand is driven by mission-critical foundry performance rather than subsidy/marketing dependence.
Current margin/cash-flow acceleration does not show structural incremental-ROIC collapse.
Advanced-node mix, margins and revenue growth do not show sustained moat shrinkage.

hard_veto_flags.veto: 현재가격이 비현실적인 Bull Case 이상을 요구
hard_veto_flags.rationale: Current price is above Base but below Bull; Bull+ is not required.

hard_veto_flags.veto: 단일 제품·단일 고객·단일 규제에 대한 치명적 종속성
hard_veto_flags.rationale: Customer concentration is material, but largest customer was 19% and no single customer/product/regulation has a documented fatal failure pathway.

hard_veto_flags.veto: 파산 또는 영구손실 확률이 기대수익에 비해 지나치게 높음
hard_veto_flags.rationale: Net cash and enormous OCF make financing failure remote; geopolitical tail risk is monitored but not quantifiable enough to establish the exact excessive-permanent-loss predicate.

key_kpis.name: overseas-fab return on capital
key_kpis.threshold: does not structurally dilute group ROIC

next_checks: 3Q26 margins, N2 yield/ramp, overseas utilization, top-customer concentration
